properties.name: dodaso.perf.controllers
properties.description: Layers to watch.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.cpu-threshold-ms
properties.description: Own CPU time (ms) at which any call is reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.enabled
properties.description: Master switch.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.entry-threshold-ms
properties.description: Total time (ms) at which an outermost call (a whole request) is reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.ignored-paths
properties.description: Request paths that are never timed (prefix match), such as static resources.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.metrics-enabled
properties.description: Record Micrometer timers when a MeterRegistry is present.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.overrides
properties.description: Per class or per class.method own-time limits in ms, for example {@code ContractService.save}.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.repository-wall-threshold-ms
properties.description: Own wall-clock time (ms) at which a repository call is reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.rest-wall-threshold-ms
properties.description: Own wall-clock time (ms) at which a call to another service is reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.batch-size
properties.description: Most incidents sent in one call.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.enabled
properties.description: Send incidents to the common service for the admin page. Needs RESTServiceClient.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.flush-interval-ms
properties.description: The writer sends what it has at least this often, in ms.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.include-stack
properties.description: Keep the stack text of STILL_RUNNING and HIGH_CPU incidents.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.max-stack-chars
properties.description: Longest stack text kept, in characters.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.queue-size
properties.description: Most incidents waiting to be sent. Newer ones are dropped when the queue is full.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.store.service-name
properties.description: Name written on each incident; empty means spring.application.name.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.ui-beans
properties.description: Watch JSF bean actions, calls to other services, and whole requests.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.wall-threshold-ms
properties.description: Own wall-clock time (ms) at which a controller or service call is reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.cpu-load-threshold
properties.description: Process CPU load (0 to 1) at or above which the busiest threads are reported.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.cpu-report-every-ms
properties.description: Busy thread reports are at least this many ms apart.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.enabled
properties.description: Watch calls that are still running, and busy threads when the process CPU is high.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.interval-ms
properties.description: How often the watchdog looks, in ms.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.repeat-ms
properties.description: The same running call is reported again only after this many ms.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.stack-depth
properties.description: Stack frames shown per thread.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.stuck-threshold-ms
properties.description: A monitored call still running after this many ms is reported with its stack.

properties.name: dodaso.perf.watchdog.top-threads
properties.description: Number of busiest threads in one report.
